title: Extend react_ui/src/api/client.ts with admin dashboard API functions
description:
Extend react_ui/src/api/client.ts with typed TypeScript API functions for the admin dashboard endpoints defined in chatbot/api/admin.py. Add TypeScript types matching the API response shapes.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/operations.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/README.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/DISPATCH.md
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts (existing API client — understand base URL configuration, fetchApi wrapper pattern, TypeScript type conventions, and error handling)
- chatbot/api/admin.py (created by task t.6 — understand the endpoint paths, query parameters, and response shapes)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY react_ui/src/api/client.ts. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

SINGLE-OWNER FILE: react_ui/src/api/client.ts is owned exclusively by this task in this phase. No other task may modify it.

Implementation details:

1. Open react_ui/src/api/client.ts and inspect the existing patterns:
   - How the base URL is configured.
   - How fetch is wrapped (fetchApi or similar helper).
   - TypeScript type convention (interface vs type, PascalCase).
   - Error handling pattern.

2. Add TypeScript types matching the Python Pydantic response models:
   - `TraceSummary`: traceId (string), sessionId (string), turnId (string), modelId (string | null), taskClass (string | null), totalLatencyMs (number), promptTokens (number), completionTokens (number), costUsdMicros (number), createdAt (string).
   - `TraceDetail`: extends TraceSummary with prompt (string), routingDecision (object), retrievalSnippets (string[]), steps (object[]), retrieveLatencyMs (number).
   - `TraceListResponse`: traces (TraceSummary[]), total (number), page (number), pageSize (number).
   - `MetricsGlobal`: totalRequests (number), totalTokens (number), totalCostUsdMicros (number), avgLatencyMs (number), modelsUsed (number).
   - `ModelMetricSummary`: modelId (string), provider (string), requestCount (number), totalPromptTokens (number), totalCompletionTokens (number), totalCostUsdMicros (number), avgLatencyMs (number), p50LatencyMs (number), p95LatencyMs (number), p99LatencyMs (number).
   - `ModelMetricsListResponse`: models (ModelMetricSummary[]).
   - `LogEvent`: eventId (string), eventType (string), timestamp (string), sessionId (string | null), turnId (string | null), details (object), severity (string).
   - `LogEventsListResponse`: events (LogEvent[]), total (number).
   - `UsageReport`: totalSessions (number), totalTurns (number), totalTokens (number), totalCostUsdMicros (number), perModel (ModelMetricSummary[]).
   - `AdminHealth`: status (string), tracesStored (number), eventsStored (number).

3. Add API functions using the existing fetchApi wrapper:
   - `fetchTraces(sessionId?: string, page?: number, pageSize?: number): Promise<TraceListResponse>` — calls GET /admin/traces with query params.
   - `fetchTraceDetail(traceId: string): Promise<TraceDetail>` — calls GET /admin/traces/{traceId}.
   - `fetchMetricsGlobal(): Promise<MetricsGlobal>` — calls GET /admin/metrics/global.
   - `fetchModelMetrics(): Promise<ModelMetricsListResponse>` — calls GET /admin/metrics/models.
   - `fetchLogEvents(eventType?: string, sessionId?: string, since?: string, limit?: number, offset?: number): Promise<LogEventsListResponse>` — calls GET /admin/logs with query params.
   - `fetchUsageReport(): Promise<UsageReport>` — calls GET /admin/usage.
   - `fetchAdminHealth(): Promise<AdminHealth>` — calls GET /admin/health.

4. Existing API functions and types in client.ts must remain unchanged.
